title.en: An Act Making the Municipality of Dapa, Province of Surigao Del Norte, a Sub-Port of Entry, and Authorizing the Appropriation of the Necessary Funds for the Operation of a Customs Service Therein
title.orig: An Act Making the Municipality of Dapa, Province of Surigao Del Norte, a Sub-Port of Entry, and Authorizing the Appropriation of the Necessary Funds for the Operation of a Customs Service Therein

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5956_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Municipality of Dapa, Province of Surigao del Norte, is hereby made a sub-port of entry under the jurisdiction of the collector of customs of Surigao, that province.

For the establishment, operation and maintenance of the customs service in the Municipality of Dapa, there is hereby authorized to be appropriated fifty thousand pesos out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act, shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 21, 1969.
